page.overview:
Who is Serra Keto?

Serra Keto was a Human female Jedi Knight. Originally a Padawan of the renowned Jedi Master Cin Drallig, she was considered his best student. Keto was a practitioner of Jar'Kai, a dual-blade fighting technique, and like her Master, was known for her skills with a lightsaber. Keto fought in the Clone Wars, serving as a Jedi General, and even fighting alongside the famed Jedi Anakin Skywalker during one battle. In 19 BBY, she was killed during Operation: Knightfall, when the Sith apprentice Darth Vader stormed the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant. Though she dueled Vader to prevent him from killing any other Jedi present, she was unable to best him.

Serra Keto was a Human female who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Throughout her Jedi training, Serra's headstrong and defiant ways confounded her Jedi Masters, nearly leading to her expulsion from the Jedi Order on more than one occasion. Cin Drallig saw through Serra's contentiousness and envisioned the great Jedi she could potentially become.

Under his tutelage, Serra's understanding of the Force grew, and her lightsaber skills blossomed, inspiring a strong bond of devotion between Padawan and Master. Though her rebelliousness eventually subsided, Serra was still prone to moments of restlessness and impatience.

In time, she became a Jedi Knight herself. Like her Master, she was a skilled lightsaber duelist and was known as Drallig's finest pupil. Keto used Jar'Kai, the art of dueling with two blades at once.
